name: carehub-plus-functions
description: CareHub Plus — Cloud Functions (integração WhatsApp Cloud API)

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:rules: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-carehub "node --test lib-test/test/rules/*.test.js"
scripts.test:unit: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-carehub "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib-test/test/unit/*.test.js"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-carehub "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib-test/test/rules/*.test.js lib-test/test/unit/*.test.js"
